$comment_hosts: Exact host names, or a leading dot for a domain and its subdomains. Every redirect is re-checked. Checked 2026-10-28: all D03-D07, D14, D17, D18 downloads are served by opendata.arcgis.com without a redirect. Do not allow '.arcgis.com': anyone can publish content on its subdomains. Add a host only after reviewing where it points. Added 2026-11-04: www.zagreb.hr for D09 (original city notices; terms allow reuse with a link).
